title: Established Fracture Detection Research Plan
content: User proposed an undergraduate computer vision research project on bone fracture detection from X-rays. Advised using the FracAtlas dataset over MURA because it provides bounding boxes for Grad-CAM validation. Recommended comparing lightweight models (MobileNet, EfficientNet) with deep architectures (DenseNet121, ResNet50), emphasizing Sensitivity/Recall over pure accuracy due to the medical context. Outlined a complete 11-point research plan including methodology, implementation, and paper structure.

title: Data Pipeline Strategy Approved
content:
User confirmed the data pipeline strategy, focusing on FracAtlasDataset implementation and specialized medical image augmentations. Key decisions:
- RGB conversion for transfer learning compatibility.
- Float32 labels for BCEWithLogitsLoss.
- Constrained augmentations: Horizontal flip and slight rotation/translation/brightness/contrast jitter are allowed.
- Prohibited augmentations: Vertical flips and Random Resized Crops are banned to preserve anatomical context and localized fracture features.
- ImageNet normalization is mandatory.

title: Refined Data Pipeline: Aspect-Ratio Preserving Resize
content: Confirmed the implementation of aspect-ratio preserving resizing (Square Padding) for the data pipeline. This prevents distortion of bone proportions and cortical thickness, ensuring rigorous medical imaging standards. A subagent will be tasked with implementing `SquarePad` and the `FracAtlasDataset` in `src/dataset.py`.
